entities.name: Karl von Normann-Ehrenfels
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Karl Friedrich Leberecht Graf von Normann-Ehrenfels was a Württembergian soldier who fought in the Napoleonic Wars. As a Philhellene he sailed to Greece to assist the Greek rebels in the Greek War of Independence, and died there of wounds received in the Battle of Peta.
